metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for Redis property namespace migration (spring.redis.* → spring.data.redis.*) during Spring Boot 3.0 upgrade. It has no semantic overlap with existing skills (which cover Flink test data injection and Next.js prefetching in unrelated domains). Peer candidates are sibling configuration migration tasks in the same upgrade workflow but target different components (Hibernate, properties migrator tool, application banner). This skill is semantically independent and should be created as a new capability.
